message: Hi Alex, it's Tom at Pulse Fitness, quick question before we talk: did an AI write this email?
reply: Hey Tom, honest answer: I used AI to help draft and speed up the outreach, but I wrote and reviewed it myself before sending. Same goes for how I work - AI helps with audits and drafts, I review everything. I only fix websites (no apps, ads, or SEO ranking promises). Happy to show you what I found on Pulse Fitness's site if you want to chat.
